summary: A four-door family saloon: a lofted three-box body with real wheel arches, cut panel shut-lines round the… joints door_fl, door_fr, door_rl, door_rr, wheel_f_l_roll …; options paint, trim_level; sockets eye_point, instrument_anchor, seat_driver, seat_pax_1 …; drivable (vehicles).
